conceptZh: 橡皮筋躲著太空人玩偶的手套，從邊緣探頭又縮回去，最後「啪」地拉成一條橫線。
object: bouncy astronaut toy and a stretchy rubber band
morph: a rubber band springs straight into a single horizontal bar
creativeAngle: 橡皮筋玩捉迷藏，最後被輕輕一彈拉直。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy, locked frontal camera. Setting: a pale-lemon stage with a lilac floor; the glyph is a bold coral 一, a single clean horizontal bar spanning about 60% of frame width. A bouncy astronaut toy in a fishbowl helmet floats a hand's width above the floor at left. The Traditional Chinese glyph 一 stays centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): a loose coral rubber band peeks in from the right edge, the astronaut lunges and drifts past upside down; the first 一 is spoken as the band pops into view. Moment two (1.8-3.5s): the band zigzags across the stage, ducking under his glove; he flicks it with one finger and it springs flat into a single horizontal bar at center; the second 一 is spoken at the twang. Moment three (3.5-5.0s): a big gold medal with a ribbon drops into the astronaut's gloves; 第一 is spoken as it lands and he hugs it, bouncing off the floor. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 一 is perfectly still and unobstructed; he floats in a slow happy loop around the bar, holding his medal up, never touching it; the glyph is perfectly still. Narration (off-screen only, Taiwanese Mandarin, unhurried, every tone clear, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「一、一、第一」, read as ㄧ、ㄧ、ㄉㄧˋ ㄧ. Timing: first utterance at about 0.5s, second at about 2.6s, the word at about 4.4s; then stop, no repeats and no extra speech. Beneath the voice only rubber twangs and a soft medal chime, no music. The single glyph is the only on-screen text; the vocabulary stays audio-only with no subtitles, watermark, clutter or flashing.
